{% autoescape off %}# {{ site.brand_name }}

> {{ site.brand_name }} is a local tour operator in Kyrgyzstan (based in Bishkek). It runs private and small-group tours with local guides: treks in the Tian Shan, yurt stays, mountain lakes (Issyk-Kul, Song-Kul, Ala-Kul), canyons and horse riding. Travellers send a request on the website or WhatsApp and get free dates and the full price {{ site.reply_time }}.

{% if site.founder_name %}Founded{% if site.founder_since %} in {{ site.founder_since }}{% endif %} by {{ site.founder_name }}{% if site.founder_role %} ({{ site.founder_role|lower }}){% endif %}.
{% endif %}Languages: English, Russian. Website: {{ site_url }}/
